rules.nodes: Give every node a stable id and label; nodes with children render as expandable branches, the rest as leaves.
rules.label: TreeView has no visible heading of its own; label names the tree for assistive tech.
rules.selection: Use selectedValue/onSelectionChange for controlled selection or defaultSelectedValue for uncontrolled.
rules.expansion: Use expandedValue/onExpandedChange for controlled branch expansion or defaultExpandedValue for uncontrolled.
